formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesCell.meets {pMain : ℕ} (mode : _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Mode)
    (hmain : P[pMain]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesCell.body mode))
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hspace : dst+4 ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : ((U+10 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hr : r ≤ U) (hi : i ≤ U) (hj : j ≤ U) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [r,i,j,dst] μ _root_.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesCell.time
      (fun _ ν => _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg ν dst (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.make mode i j r).cells ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SameOutside μ ν dst 4) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For candidate mode $m$ and natural controls $r,i,j\le U$, suppose procedure $p$ is the corresponding cell body, addresses fit words, four destination cells fit memory, and $U+10$ fits a word. The procedure writes the four cells of $\operatorname{make}(m,i,j,r)$ in its declared time and changes no other memory cells.

This cell contract gives the literal four-field candidate record from which the complete owner-record array is assembled.
